title: The Secret of the Temple
synopsis: An expedition enters ancient ruins. Each clip ends in a decision.
coverPrompt: Vertical cinematic still, ancient stone temple gate at dawn in the jungle, mist, no text, no people.

nodes.title: The Temple Gate
nodes.ttsText: What do you think Jeff should do? Enter the temple, or climb the ridge?
nodes.startImagePrompt: Vertical cinematic still, mossy stone temple gate at dawn, jungle mist, no text, no people.
nodes.endImagePrompt: Vertical cinematic still, dark temple doorway with stairs going down, torch light, no text, no people.

nodes.title: The Guardian
nodes.ttsText: Jeff crosses the gate. The temple was waiting for him.
nodes.endImagePrompt: Vertical cinematic still, giant stone guardian statue inside a dark temple, single torch, no text, no people.

nodes.title: The Ridge
nodes.ttsText: What do you think Jeff should do? Keep climbing, or head back to the temple?
nodes.endImagePrompt: Vertical cinematic still, grassy ridge above jungle ruins at dusk, winding path, no text, no people.

nodes.title: The Fall
nodes.endImagePrompt: Vertical cinematic still, broken rope bridge over a jungle abyss at night, no text, no people.
